providers.heading: Metadata providers
providers.intro: Set personal keys for your account. They apply immediately to search, item details, and barcode lookup. Server defaults are used when no personal key is set.
providers.keepHint: Leave a field blank to keep its current key. Saved keys are never shown. To replace a key, enter the new value without selecting Remove.
providers.remove: Remove my saved key and use the server default

uses.tmdb: Finds movies and TV shows and supplies posters, descriptions, cast, and release details.
uses.rawg: Finds video games and supplies cover images, descriptions, platforms, and release details.
uses.discogs: Finds physical music releases, such as CDs and vinyl, from scanned or entered barcodes.
uses.musicbrainz: Finds music albums and supplies artist, release, label, and track details.
uses.openlibrary: Finds books by title or ISBN and supplies covers, descriptions, and author details.
